description: Deterministic same-round retargeting discriminator using only T6 troops and no heroes. WIP attacks with 100 Lancers followed by 400 Marksmen against minxxx's 1 Lancer followed by 499 Marksmen. The WIP Lancers are expected to kill the single defender Lancer comfortably before WIP Marksmen act. Using the latest captured account stats, no-retargeting predicts 303 defender Marksmen surviving, while attack-time retargeting predicts 282 defender Marksmen surviving. A result near 303 supports skipping the Marksman attack when its snapshotted target is exhausted; a result near 282 supports retargeting it to the living Marksmen. The captured report stats must be substituted into both unchanged interpretations before the result is classified.
